comment: Curated irregular-verb paradigm table (ANCHOR tier). Fills ThamizhiMorph FST lexicon gaps for common verbs whose PAST stem is irregular/suppletive and therefore absent from the primary FSTs. This is a hand-verified encoded rule table — the same grounding model as core/decoder.py's rule tables (design D-011: grounding = human-encoded rule table at design time + per-claim citation at runtime). It is NOT a guesser: only listed lemmas with verified past stems are matched, and every claim cites this table. Guesser FSTs remain excluded because they return WRONG lemmas (கொடுத் for கொடு, வந் for வா).
authority: Standard Tamil verb paradigms (Nannūl வினையியல் classes); forms cross-checked against ThamizhiMorph output where the FST covers a sibling form.
